title: Aoi, rounds 1 and 2 (aoi-meshy-1)
blurb: A real rigged 3D model, made the way Kuro round 3 was: Meshy smart topology (1,050 polygons, A-pose) from ChatGPT picture c2, textured in a second pass on a UV layout with her face as one piece, Meshy auto-rig at 1.1 m. Idle and walk are the game's. Beside her: the in-game Meshy Eric and Mio, and Kuro round 3. Drag to turn, wheel to zoom. Round 2 (aoi-2): from picture e2, her head a little smaller; the viewer shows her hands as Meshy made them (the game scales them to 0.75).
